originalEntry.description: A 2-minute sand-art animation of 250 years of U.S. history, with music and sound design, generated in code by Claude Code without Blender or Three.js.
originalEntry.description_zh: 2 分钟沙画动画讲美国 250 年历史，带配乐音效，纯代码生成，没用 Blender 或 Three.js。
originalEntry.prompt: Make a 2-minute sand animation that tells the story of 250 years of U.S. history. Keep it lively, engaging, and tasteful. Add appropriate background music and sound design.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 做一段 2 分钟的沙画动画，讲述美国 250 年的历史。保持生动、吸引人、有品位。加上合适的背景音乐和音效设计。
originalEntry.note: Author: one prompt, no revisions; about 30% of a Pro plan's 5-hour limit.
